text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong before it actually happens. Once risks are known, you can develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or the chance of them occurring. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if a problem does appear. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By reviewing the situation regularly, you can spot new dangers early and adjust your plans. Good risk management protects your goals and helps you stay calm when difficulties arise.
